organ: GPT-5.6 Sol / OpenAI isolated non-production container
purpose: Prevent startup from silently recreating a missing persisted canonical user session after UnifiedDB identity state already exists.

mechanism.before: IdentityRouter always called ensure_session for both canonical users before startup normalization; a deleted permanent session in an otherwise persisted canonical identity could be recreated and hidden from drift detection.
mechanism.after: Only a genuinely empty identity state may bootstrap canonical sessions. If canonical users already exist, startup performs read/validate normalization only. If users are empty while persisted sessions exist, bootstrap fails closed before mutation.

durable_regressions: fresh boot creates exactly Gabriel/Andreas and exactly session:gabriel/session:andreas
existing canonical state with deleted Gabriel session fails startup and leaves the session absent
existing noncanonical permanent session id still fails startup
empty users plus persisted orphan session fails before canonical-user bootstrap and preserves corrupted evidence

sqlite_identity_bootstrap_micro_falsifie.scope: Reconstructed exact bootstrap/normalization mechanism against in-memory SQLite schema; not full PR-head pytest.
observations: fresh empty identity bootstraps two users and two sessions
deleted persisted canonical session remains missing and startup fails closed
orphan persisted session with no users blocks bootstrap without mutation

not_proven: packaged startup/restart behavior inside OCI image
real Clerk browser WebSocket PTY behavior
